summary: American Express filed a routine Form 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) reporting the October 30, 2026 issuance of $3.0B aggregate senior notes under its existing Form S-3 shelf: $1.5B 5.447% fixed-to-floating notes due 2030, $1.15B 5.817% fixed-to-floating notes due 2034, and $350M floating-rate notes due 2030. Notes were issued under the 2007 senior indenture with BNY Mellon as trustee, pursuant to an October 26, 2026 prospectus supplement. Counsel opinion filed as Exhibit 5. This is an ordinary debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no equity terms, board recommendation, or deal clock apply.
